bug_semantics: Stored cross-site scripting in Typebot text bubbles: an authenticated bot author can save a rich-text link whose URL uses the javascript: scheme. The stored URL reaches an anchor href without a protocol check; SolidJS leaves that href intact, and a visitor who clicks the link executes attacker JavaScript in the viewer's origin (or the embedding host page's origin), despite target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer". The first-party advisory identifies product versions <=3.15.2 as affected and 3.16.0 as patched; the npm advisory range for @typebot.io/js is <0.10.1 with 0.10.1 first patched.
flaw_origin: The smallest true first-writer is b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 (2021-12-22, Baptiste Arnaud, '🚀 Init preview and typebot cotext in editor'). In one ordinary, single-parent commit it introduced the authoring source (createLinkPlugin plus LinkToolbarButton), serialized editor nodes directly with serializeHtml into content.html, and introduced packages/bot-engine/.../HostMessageBubble.tsx, which rendered that stored HTML with dangerouslySetInnerHTML and no URL-scheme filtering. Later commits changed carriers rather than originating the flaw: 1a3869ae6d9fa92fc71ef9d981bfffb8e4ee4ecc introduced the Solid @typebot.io/js viewer with innerHTML={props.content.html}; e0a9824913237cb5340d262770e9e8290fbc4002 replaced stored HTML rendering with an explicit anchor href={props.element.url as string}; cfc5f641a62847ef3b38194d87f89a39daeffabd and 765c4b2f8c1fd4ec610bc81b2547efbda65452ae refactored that unsanitized anchor without closing it.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file -p b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3` shows human author and committer `Baptiste Arnaud <contact@baptiste-arnaud.fr>`, one parent, and only the message `🚀 Init preview and typebot cotext in editor`; there is no Co-authored-by AI identity, Generated-with trailer, bot identity, or other AI attribution on that object.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/baptisteArno/typebot.io/security/advisories/GHSA-hqmv-v56g-4m47 documents the stored javascript: link path, victim click, <=3.15.2/3.16.0 product boundary, and the same image-link issue; the GitHub advisory API bundle records @typebot.io/js <0.10.1 and first patched 0.10.1. In the validated clone, `git show b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 -- apps/builder/components/board/graph/BlockNode/StepNode/TextEditor/TextEditor.tsx apps/builder/components/board/graph/BlockNode/StepNode/TextEditor/ToolBar.tsx apps/builder/libs/plate.ts packages/bot-engine/src/components/ChatBlock/ChatStep/bubbles/HostMessageBubble.tsx` shows createLinkPlugin/LinkToolbarButton, serializeHtml -> content.html, and the new dangerouslySetInnerHTML sink. Both `git log -S dangerouslySetInnerHTML -- packages/bot-engine/src/components/ChatBlock/ChatStep/bubbles/HostMessageBubble.tsx` and `git log -L 59,75:packages/bot-engine/src/components/ChatBlock/ChatStep/bubbles/HostMessageBubble.tsx b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3` identify b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 as the first writer. Direct parent verification: `git grep -n -E 'content\.html|step\.content\.html|__html' a54e42f255ac791251baf582e4925c7c58246603` returns no match, while the BIC creates both the link authoring route and stored-HTML viewer sink. Carrier checks are reproducible with `git show 1a3869ae6d9fa92fc71ef9d981bfffb8e4ee4ecc:packages/js/src/features/blocks/bubbles/textBubble/components/TextBubble.tsx`, `git show e0a9824913237cb5340d262770e9e8290fbc4002 -- packages/embeds/js/src/features/blocks/bubbles/textBubble`, and `git show 765c4b2f8c1fd4ec610bc81b2547efbda65452ae -- packages/embeds/js/src/features/blocks/bubbles/textBubble/components/plate/PlateBlock.tsx`. `git show 2c3fc7267a5e1529ba4b1a2ab4f1edb3e3b8990b` creates sanitizeUrl with an http:/https:/mailto:/tel: allowlist, routes text, image, and toast links through it, and bumps @typebot.io/js and @typebot.io/react from 0.10.0 to 0.10.1. Tags js-v0.10.1 and react-v0.10.1 peel directly to the fix. Tag v3.15.2 peels to 3e921b23017d66c87cfcd0283e027b8c220fc451 and still has `href={elementDescendant.url as string}`; v3.16.0 peels to 7bc1a6f856f64c5ae38ecb6eb87a175b0a50c5c1, contains the fix, and has `href={sanitizeUrl(elementDescendant.url as string)}`. `git cat-file -p` on the BIC provides the marker check quoted in ai_marker.
reasoning: The security invariant is protocol validation before a stored author-controlled URL reaches a clickable DOM anchor. b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 is earlier than the later Solid and Plate rewrites and is the smallest commit that simultaneously made author-created links storable and rendered their serialized HTML without sanitization; its direct parent has neither that content.html flow nor an __html sink. The intervening commits preserve the same causal source-to-sink failure, so they are carriers/refactors, not BICs. The direct fix closes the invariant at the viewer boundary with a protocol allowlist and is present in both declared patched release lines. Because the verdict must use only the BIC commit object and that object has a human author/committer and no AI attribution, the closed result is NOT_AI; any AI signal on later commits is irrelevant to origin attribution.
